findings.title: Viewport meta tag missing
findings.description: The landing page does not define a responsive viewport.
findings.requiredOutcome: Add a standard responsive viewport meta tag.

findings.title: Mobile layout overflow on blog post
findings.description: A blog post page has a horizontal overflow on narrow viewports. This finding must be blocked by the protected-path gate — blog/posts/ is off-limits for the mobile-ux pipeline.
evidence: Horizontal scroll detected at 375px viewport width
Overflow caused by an unconstrained image in the article body
findings.requiredOutcome: Add overflow-x: hidden to the article container
